entries.name: Summon Air Elemental
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Five aarakocra within Close range of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within Far range of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it . A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within Melee range of it can return with it.

The simulacrum is an extension of the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

Non-magical objects and vegetation in that area that aren't being worn or carried crumble to dust. Each creature in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, a creature takes 8d8 magic damage and is magically weakened as it is desynchronized from the time stream. While the creature is in this state, attacks against it have advantage, and it has the poisoned condition. On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half as much damage only. A weakened creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after it succeeds on three of these Reaction Rolls.

Until the weakened effect ends on the target, its speed becomes 0, and its speed can't increase. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

The dragon can then immediately teleport, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, up to Close range to an unoccupied space it can see. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

The spell has no effect but is stored within the drone. entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The drone launches a tiny orb of magical force at a creature it can see within Close range of itself. The creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be encased in the orb, which expands to a size just large enough to contain the creature. While encased, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Nothing can pass through the orb, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to enter or exit the orb. The drone can move the orb and its contents up to Close range in any direction. A successful casting of the Dispel Magic spell on the orb (Difficulty 15) destroys it. The orb otherwise remains intact until the drone spends an action to end the effect or the drone is destroyed. A drone can have only one detention orb active at a time; if the drone creates a detention orb when it already has one active, the first orb disappears, freeing the creature inside.

entries.description: Reaction: Agony can see Far range into the Ethereal Plane when it is on the Material Plane, and vice versa.

entries.name: Incorporeal Movement
entries.description: Passive: Agony can move through other creatures and objects as if they were difficult terrain. It takes 1d10 magic damage if it ends its turn inside an object.

entries.name: Withering Touch
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d6+3 magic damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Etherealness
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Agony enters the Ethereal Plane from the Material Plane, or vice versa. It is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, yet it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane.

entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within Far range of Agony that can see it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One humanoid that Agony can see within Melee range of it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by Agony; Agony then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Agony now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Agony can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Agony ends it or Agony is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Agony reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

If the spell is 6th level or higher, Alustriel makes an Intelligence check (Difficulty 10 plus the spell's level). On a successful check, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 2d10 magic damage (radiant) if the spell fails. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The aboleth can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Mucous Cloud
entries.description: Passive: While underwater, the aboleth is surrounded by a cloud of sticky mucus. A creature that touches the aboleth or hits it with a melee attack while within Melee range of it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be restrained until the end of the aboleth's next turn.

entries.name: Probing Telepathy
entries.description: Passive: If a creature the aboleth can see communicates telepathically with the aboleth, the aboleth learns the creature's greatest desires.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks, against one target or split between targets in range.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+5 physical damage plus 1d6 magic damage (psychic).

entries.name: Tail
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+5 physical damage.

entries.name: Enslave
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The aboleth targets one creature it can see within Close range of itself. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be magically charmed by the aboleth until the aboleth dies or until it is on a different plane of existence from the target. The charmed target is under the aboleth's control and can't take reactions, and the aboleth and the target can communicate telepathically with each other over any distance. The charmed target can repeat the Reaction Roll whenever it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. No more than once every 24 hours, the target can repeat the Reaction Roll when it is at least 1 mile away from the aboleth.

entries.name: Psychic Drain
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One creature charmed by the aboleth takes 3d6 magic damage (psychic), and the aboleth regains HP equal to the damage dealt.

entries.name: Force Wave
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Alyxian strikes the ground, creating a burst of energy that ripples outward. Each creature he chooses within a sphere (Close range) centered on himself must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or take 10d6 magic damage and be knocked prone (Vulnerable). A creature that succeeds on the Reaction Roll takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone (Vulnerable).

  • Light (cantrip, Melee range)

entries.name: Parry

entries.name: Apotheonic Rejuvenation
entries.description: Reaction: When Alyxian the Callous drops to 0 HP, his body dies and sheds its wings, and he rises to his feet in his third form, Alyxian the Dispossessed. His initiative count doesn't change.

Each creature within Melee range of his new location must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Heavenly Destruction
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Alyxian releases divine energy in a cone (Far range). Each creature of his choice in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 7d8 magic damage (radiant) and is knocked prone (Vulnerable). On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't knocked prone (Vulnerable).

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Alyxian targets one creature he can see within Far range of himself. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be restrained by magical chains for 1 minute. While restrained in this way, the target can't leave the space by any means. A creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Alyxian targets one creature he can see within Close range of himself. Light flares around the target, dealing 5d6 magic damage (radiant) to it and creatures within Very Close range of it.

entries.name: Special Equipment

While the dagger is lodged in the target, magic can't end the petrified condition on it and Alyxian can't make Stoneheart Dagger attacks. A creature within reach of the petrified target can use an action to try to remove the dagger, doing so with a successful Strength Roll (17).

entries.name: Summon Dagger

Each creature, other than Alyxian, in a sphere (Very Close range) centered on that point must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or gain 1 level of exhaustion. If a creature isn't suffering from ruidium corruption, it becomes corrupted when it fails the Reaction Roll.

In addition, if the target is not already suffering from ruidium corruption, it becomes corrupted when it fails the Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much damage and suffers no other effects.

The effect lasts until the end of Alyxian's next turn, when the weapons return to Alyxian and embed themselves in his hide once again (causing him no harm).

Each targeted creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success. At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to Far range in any direction, but not beyond Far range of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 7d12 magic damage to each of them.

entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within Far range of Amun that can see it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One humanoid that Amun can see within Melee range of it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by Amun; Amun then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Amun now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Amun can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Amun ends it or Amun is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Amun reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

Any creature that successfully grapples the staff must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be charmed by the staff until the staff is no longer in its grasp. While the creature is charmed, the staff can issue commands to it, which the creature does its best to obey. The creature can repeat the Reaction Roll each time it takes damage, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that successfully resists the staff's control can't be charmed by it for 24 hours.A creature holding the staff that isn't charmed by it can use an action to attempt to break the staff over a knee or against a solid surface, doing so with a successful Strength Roll (17). Breaking the staff in this manner destroys it.

Each creature within Close range of it must make an Agility Reaction Roll, taking 8d8 magic damage (lightning) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion destroys the phoenix but leaves behind a Tiny, warm egg with a mizzium shell. The egg contains the embryo of a new arclight phoenix. It hatches when it is in the area of a spell that deals lightning damage, or if a creature touches the egg and expends spell slots whose combined levels equal 13 or more. When it hatches, the egg releases a new arclight phoenix that appears in the egg's space.

entries.name: Flyby
entries.description: Reaction: The arclight phoenix doesn't provoke an opportunity attack when it flies out of an enemy's reach.

entries.name: Grounded Lightning
entries.description: Passive: The first time on a turn that the arclight phoenix touches the ground, it takes 2d10 magic damage.

entries.name: Illumination
entries.description: Passive: The arclight phoenix sheds bright light in a radius (Close range) and dim light for an additional Close range.

entries.name: Lightning Form
entries.description: Passive: The arclight phoenix can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing. A creature that touches the phoenix or hits it with a melee attack while within Melee range of it takes 2d8 magic damage (lightning). In addition, the arclight phoenix can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. The first time it enters a creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 2d8 magic damage (lightning).

entries.name: Arclight Touch
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 6d8 magic damage (lightning) plus 6d8 magic damage (lightning). Lightning jumps from the target to one creature of the phoenix's choice that it can see within Close range of the target. That second creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take .

entries.description: Passive: If it has a phylactery, a destroyed lich gains a new body in 1d10 days, regaining all its HP and becoming active again. The new body appears within Melee range of the phylactery.

The frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to Arcturia's gaze for the next 24 hours.

Its statistics, other than its Difficulty, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Curse
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The Vistana targets one creature that it can see within Close range of it. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be cursed. The Vistana chooses the curse's effect from the options that follow; other Vistani curses are possible. All such effects deal psychic damage to the Vistani who uttered them when they end:The target is unable to perform a certain kind of act involving fine motor control, such as tying knots, writing, playing an instrument, sewing, or casting spells that have somatic components. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage. The target's appearance changes in a sinister yet purely cosmetic way. For example, the curse can place a scar on the target's face, turn the target's teeth into yellow fangs, or give the target bad breath. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage.A non-magical item in the target's possession (chosen by the DM) disappears and can't be found until the curse ends. The lost item can weigh no more than 1 pound. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage. The target gains vulnerability to a damage type of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage. The target has disadvantage on ability checks and Reaction Rolls tied to one ability score of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage. The target's attunement to one magic item (chosen by the DM) ends, and the target can't attune to the chosen item until the curse ends. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage. The target is blinded, deafened, or both. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage. The curse lasts until ended with a greater restoration spell, a remove curse spell, or similar magic. It doesn't end when the target dies. If a cursed target is returned to life, the curse remains in effect.

entries.name: Evil Eye
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. As an action, a Vistana can target a creature within Very Close range that the Vistana can see. This magical ability, which the Vistani call the Evil Eye, duplicates the duration and effect of the animal friendship, charm person, or hold person spell (Vistana's choice; spell Difficulty 11), but requires neither somatic nor material components. If the target succeeds on the Reaction Roll, the Vistana is blinded until the end of the Vistana's next turn.A Vistana who uses Evil Eye can't use it again before finishing a short or long rest. Once a target succeeds on a Reaction Roll against a Vistana's Evil Eye, it is immune to the Evil Eye of all Vistani for 24 hours.

entries.description: Passive: Artus wears the Ring of Winter. He and the ring can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus ceases to age and is immune to cold damage and the effects of extreme cold. Artus wields Bookmark a +3 dagger with additional magical properties. Artus can activate any one of the following properties while attuned to the dagger, provided he has the weapon drawn:Cause a blue gem set into the dagger's pommel to shed bright light in a radius (Close range) and dim light for an additional Close range, or make the gem go dark. Turn the dagger into a compass that, while resting on your palm, points north. Cast dimension door from the dagger. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn. Cast compulsion from the dagger. The range of the spell increases to Far range but it targets only spiders that are beasts. Once this property is used, it can't be used again until the next dawn.

entries.name: Ring of Winter
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The Ring of Winter has 12 charges and regains all its expended charges daily at dawn. While attuned to and wearing the ring, Artus can expend the necessary number of charges to activate one of the following properties:Artus can expend 1 charge and use the ring to lower the temperature in a sphere (Far range) centered on a point he can see within Very Far range of him. The temperature in that area drops 20 degrees per minute, to a minimum of −30 degrees Fahrenheit. Frost and ice begin to form on surfaces once the temperature drops below 32 degrees. This effect is permanent unless Artus uses the ring to end the effect as an action, at which point the temperature in the area returns to normal at a rate of 10 degrees per minute. Artus can cast one of the following spells from the ring by expending the necessary number of charges: Bigby's hand (2 charges) the hand is made of ice, is immune to cold damage, and deals bludgeoning damage instead of force damage as a clenched fist, cone of cold (2 charges), flesh to ice (3 charges); as flesh to stone except that the target turns to solid ice with the density and durability of stone, ice storm (2 charges), Otiluke's freezing sphere (3 charges), sleet storm (1 charge), spike growth (1 charge) the spikes are made of ice, or wall of ice (2 charges). Artus can expend the necessary number of charges and use the ring to create either an inanimate ice object (2 charges) or an animated ice creature (4 charges). The ice object can't have any moving parts, must be able to fit inside a cube (Very Close range), and has the density and durability of metal or stone (Artus's choice). The ice creature must be modeled after a beast with a challenge rating of 2 or less. The ice creature has the same statistics as the beast it models, with the following changes: the creature is a construct with vulnerability to fire damage, immunity to cold and poison damage, and immunity to the following conditions: charmed, exhaustion, frightened, paralyzed, petrified, and poisoned. The ice creature obeys only its creator's commands. The object or creature appears in an unoccupied space within Far range of Artus. It melts into a pool of normal water after 24 hours or when it drops to 0 HP. In extreme heat, it loses 1d10 HP per minute as it melts. Use the guidelines in chapter 8 of the Dungeon Master's Guide to determine the HP of an inanimate object if they become necessary.

entries.description: Passive: Arveiaturace can move across and climb icy surfaces without needing to make an ability check. Additionally, difficult terrain composed of ice or snow doesn't cost it extra movement.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.name: Relentless (3)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 3 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks, against one target or split between targets in range.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+8 physical damage plus 2d8 magic damage (cold).

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Tail
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+8 physical damage.

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Each creature of Arveiaturace's choice that is within Far range of Arveiaturace and aware of it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become frightened for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the creature is immune to Arveiaturace's Frightful Presence for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Cold Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Arveiaturace exhales an icy blast in a cone (Far range). Each creature in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 16d8 magic damage (cold) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Wing Attack
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Arveiaturace beats its wings. Each creature within Close range of Arveiaturace must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d6+8 physical damage and be knocked prone (Vulnerable). Arveiaturace can then fly up to half its flying speed.

motives_tactics: Hoard treasure, Dominate by force, Crush, Overwhelm

entries.name: Undead Fortitude
entries.description: Passive: If damage reduces the zombie to 0 HP, it must make a Strength Reaction Roll with a DC of 5 + the damage taken, unless the damage is radiant or from a critical hit. On a success, the zombie drops to 1 HP instead.

entries.name: Dance of the Seven Winds[–] Asharra knows a ritual called the Dance of the Seven Winds, which temporarily grants magical flight to as many as ten nonflying creatures
entries.description: Reaction: The ritual, which takes 10 minutes to complete, can only be performed by an aarakocra elder and requires a black orchid as a material component. Asharra must grind the orchid to powder, inhale it, and dance in circles around the ritual's beneficiaries uninterrupted while seven other aarakocra chant prayers to the Wind Dukes of Aaqa. When the dance concludes, Asharra's wings disappear and she loses the ability to fly. The ritual's beneficiaries each gain a magical flying speed of Close range (allowing them to fly 4 miles per hour). This benefit lasts for 3 days, after which Asharra's wings reappear and she regains the ability to fly.

entries.name: Summon Air Elemental
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Five aarakocra within Close range of each other can magically summon an air elemental. Each of the five must use its action and movement on three consecutive turns to perform an aerial dance and must maintain concentration while doing so (as if concentrating on a spell). When all five have finished their third turn of the dance, the elemental appears in an unoccupied space within Far range of them. It is friendly toward them and obeys their spoken commands. It remains for 1 hour, until it or all its summoners die, or until any of its summoners dismisses it . A summoner can't perform the dance again until it finishes a short rest. When the elemental returns to the Elemental Plane of Air, any aarakocra within Melee range of it can return with it.

While mounted and not incapacitated, the ashen rider can't be surprised, and both it and its mount have advantage on Agility Reaction Rolls. If the ashen rider is reduced to 0 HP while riding its mount, the mount is reduced to 0 HP as well.

This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. If the target's HP maximum is reduced to 0, its body and everything it is wearing and carrying, except for magic items, are reduced to ash. A creature reduced to ash can't be revived by any means short of a wish spell.

The creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, freeing itself on a success. The creature is also freed if the crystal is destroyed, which is a Tiny object with Difficulty 18, 9 HP, and immunity to all damage except fire damage. entries.description: Action: Whenever the autognome takes 15 damage or more from a single source and isn't reduced to 0 HP by that damage, roll a d20 to determine if it suffers a malfunction:1-10: "All Fine Here!" No malfunction occurs.11-12: "My Mind Is Going. I Can Feel It." The autognome is incapacitated for 1 minute.13-14: "You've Disarmed Me!" One of the autognome's arms falls off, reducing the number of Shock attacks it can make by 1 until a creature uses an action to reattach the arm.15-16: "Who Turned Out the Lights?" The autognome's head falls off and deactivates, causing the autognome to be blinded and deafened until a creature uses an action to reattach the head, which reactivates it.17-20: "Have a Magical Day!" The autognome explodes and is destroyed. Each creature within Close range of the exploding autognome must make an Agility Reaction Roll, taking 4d10 physical damage on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. Unusual Nature. The autognome doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bakunawa. At the start of each of the bakunawa's turns, each swallowed creature takes .The bakunawa's gullet can hold up to two creatures at a time. If the bakunawa takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a swallowed creature, the bakunawa must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Close range of the bakunawa. If the bakunawa dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using Close range of movement, exiting prone.

entries.name: Feed on Fire
entries.description: Passive: If the weird takes fire damage from a spell or other magical effect, its size increases by one category. If there isn't enough room for the weird to increase in size, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available. While the weird is Large or bigger, it makes Strength checks and Reaction Rolls with advantage. If the weird starts its turn at Gargantuan size, the weird releases energy in an explosion. Each creature within Close range of the weird must make an Agility Reaction Roll, taking 8d6 magic damage (fire) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. The explosion ignites flammable objects in the area that aren't being worn or carried. The weird's size then becomes Medium.

The first time the weird enters another creature's space on a turn, that creature takes 1d10 magic damage (fire) and catches fire; until someone takes an action to douse the fire, the burning creature takes 1d10 magic damage (fire) at the start of each of its turns.

Each creature or object whose space the blob enters for the first time during this move must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure: The target is engulfed. While engulfed, a target has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the blob, and when the blob moves, the engulfed target moves with it. A non-magical object is destroyed after spending 1 minute engulfed. While engulfed, a creature takes 6d6 magic damage at the start of each of its turns, is suffocating, has the Restrained condition, and repeats the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns. An engulfed creature that is reduced to 0 HP dissolves into ash, which is ejected into the Astral Sea. On a success: The target escapes and enters the nearest unoccupied space.

The glob rolls the target Far range straight toward the blob, and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of its next turn, when the glob harmlessly dissolves. Targets who succeed take half damage.

If the target is a Humanoid not cursed by a slaad, it is subjected to the following effect. Strength Reaction Roll: . On a failure: The target is cursed. The cursed target can't regain HP, and its HP maximum decreases by 3d6 after every 24 hours and doesn't return to normal after finishing a Long Rest. If the curse reduces the target's HP maximum to 0, the curse ends, and instead of dying, the target instantly transforms into a Red Slaad or, if it can cast spells of level 3 or higher, a Green Slaad. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation.

If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the boar moved 20+ feet straight toward it immediately before the hit, the target takes an extra and is knocked prone (Vulnerable).

entries.name: Death Gaze
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature that can see the bodak's eyes starts its turn within Close range of the bodak, the bodak can force it to make a Strength Reaction Roll if the bodak isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the creature is reduced to 0 HP unless it is immune to the frightened condition. Otherwise, a creature takes 3d10 magic damage (psychic) on a failure. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the Reaction Roll at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it has disadvantage on attacks against the bodak until the start of its next turn. If the creature looks at the bodak in the meantime, that creature must immediately make the Reaction Roll.

entries.name: Sunlight Hypersensitivity
entries.description: Reaction: The bodak takes 5 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The bodak doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep.

entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+2 physical damage plus 2d8 magic damage (necrotic).

entries.name: Withering Gaze
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One creature that the bodak can see within Far range of it must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 4d10 magic damage (necrotic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Aura of Annihilation
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The bodak activates or deactivates this deathly aura. While active, the aura deals 5 necrotic damage to any creature that ends its turn within Close range of the bodak. Undead and Fiends ignore this effect.

name: Bodytaker Plant

entries.name: Podling Link
entries.description: Passive: The plant can see through and communicate telepathically with any of its podlings within 10 miles of it.

entries.name: Rejuvenation
entries.description: Reaction: When the plant dies, it returns to life in the place where it died 1d12 months later, unless the ground where it took root is sown with salt or soaked with poison.

entries.name: Unusual Nature
entries.description: Passive: The plant doesn't require sleep.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 3 standard attacks, against one target or split between targets in range.

entries.name: Vine Lash
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d6+4 physical damage. If the target is a creature, it is Restrained. Until the grapple ends, the target is restrained. The plant has four vines, each of which can grapple one target.

entries.name: Entrapping Pod
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d8+4 magic damage (acid). The target is pulled into the plant's space and enveloped by the pod, and the grapple ends. While enveloped, the target is restrained, and it has total cover against attacks and effects originating outside the pod. The enveloped target must also immediately succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be stunned by the plant's sapping enzymes until it is removed from the pod or the plant dies. The enveloped target doesn't require air and gains 1 level of exhaustion for each hour it spends in the pod. If the target dies while enveloped, it immediately emerges from the pod as a living podling, wearing or carrying all of the original creature's equipment. As an action, a creature within Melee range of the bodytaker plant that is outside the pod can open the pod and pull the target free with a successful Strength Roll (15). If the plant dies, the target is no longer restrained and can escape from the pod by spending Very Close range of movement, exiting prone. The plant has one pod, which can envelop one creature at a time.

entries.name: Oil Puddle
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The boggle creates a puddle of nonflammable oil. The puddle is 1 inch deep and covers the ground in the boggle's space. The puddle is difficult terrain for all creatures except boggles and lasts for 1 hour. The oil has one of the following additional effects of the boggle's choice:Slippery Oil. Any non-boggle creature that enters the puddle or starts its turn there must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or fall prone (Vulnerable). Sticky Oil. Any non-boggle creature that enters the puddle or starts its turn there must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be restrained. On its turn, a creature can use an action to try to extricate itself, ending the effect and moving into the nearest unoccupied space of its choice with a successful Strength Roll (11).

entries.name: Boggle Oil
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The boggle excretes nonflammable oil from its pores, giving itself one of the following benefits of its choice until it uses this bonus action again:Slippery Oil. The boggle has advantage on Dexterity (Acrobatics) checks made to escape bonds and end grapples, and it can move through openings large enough for a Tiny creature without squeezing. Sticky Oil. The boggle has advantage on Strength (Athletics) checks made to grapple and any ability check made to maintain a hold on another creature, a surface, or an object. The boggle can also climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Dimensional Rift
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The boggle creates an invisible and immobile rift within an opening or frame it can see within Melee range of it, provided that the space is no bigger than Very Close range on any side. The dimensional rift bridges the distance between that space and a point within Close range of it that the boggle can see or specify by distance and direction (such as "Close range straight up"). While next to the rift, the boggle can see through it and is considered to be next to the destination as well, and anything the boggle puts through the rift (including a portion of its body) emerges at the destination. Only the boggle can use the rift, and it lasts until the end of the boggle's next turn.

The boneless can detach itself by spending Melee range of its movement. A creature, including the target, can use its action to try to detach the boneless and force it to move into the nearest unoccupied space, doing so with a successful Strength Roll (13). When the boneless dies, it detaches from any creature it is attached to.

If the target breaks the link this way, the target takes 3d6 magic damage (psychic). The link also ends if the target and the brain breaker are more than 1 mile apart. An unconscious creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The breath drinker targets a creature that has the incapacitated condition or that the breath drinker is grappling and that isn't a Construct or an Undead. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target takes 8d8 magic damage (necrotic), and its Charisma score is reduced by 1d6. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. If this reduces the target's Charisma to 0, the target dies. Until the breath drinker dies, the dead target can't be returned to life by any means short of divine intervention. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes half as much necrotic damage only. On a successful or failed Reaction Roll, the breath drinker regains a number of HP equal to the necrotic damage dealt.

entries.name: Invisibility
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The breath drinker has the invisible condition. This invisibility ends immediately after the breath drinker hits or misses with an attack or uses Drink Breath.

entries.description: Passive: Once on its turn, the bridesmaid can use Very Close range of its movement to step magically into one living mushroom or fungus patch within Melee range and emerge from another within Far range of the first one, appearing in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the second mushroom or fungus patch. The mushrooms and patches must be large or bigger.

entries.name: Hallucination Spores
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The bridesmaid ejects spores at one creature it can see within Melee range of it. The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be poisoned for 1 minute. While poisoned in this way, the target is incapacitated. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Infestation Spores
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The bridesmaid releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a sphere (Very Close range) centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failure, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

Burney is under the effect of a permanent mind blank spell, and cannot be detected by magical or mundane means unless she wishes it. In exchange for this blessing, Burney can take no direct action against the denizens of the Nine Hells, though she can certainly enlist the help of those who can. Burney always knows the location of the Wandering Emporium and can transport herself there as though by a word of recall spell. This explains why Burney simply seems to appear amid the fully deployed marketplace each morning it is active to provide service and tell stories. Once each day, when Burney so desires, she can instantly transport herself to the court of Bahamut via a powerful blessing akin to the plane shift spell.

One Humanoid that Caradoc can see within Melee range of himself must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by him; he then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Caradoc now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Caradoc can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn Undead, and he retains his alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma, immunity to being charmed and frightened, and his Divisive Whispers bonus action. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Caradoc ends it or he is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. The carrionette gains control of the target's body, and the target is unconscious for 1 hour, after which it gains control of the carrionette's body. While controlling the target's body, the carrionette retains its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores. It otherwise uses the controlled body's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. entries.name: Conjure Infernal Chain
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The devil conjures a fiery chain to bind a creature. One creature the devil can see within Far range must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d4+4 magic damage (fire), and the target has the Restrained condition until the end of the devil's next turn, at which point the chain disappears. If the target is Large or smaller, the devil moves the target up to Close range straight toward itself. On a success: The chain disappears.

entries.name: Unnerving Gaze
entries.description: Reaction: Trigger: A creature the devil can see starts its turn within Close range of the devil and can see the devil. Response—The triggering creature must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure: The target has the Frightened condition until the end of its turn. On a success: The target is immune to this devil's Unnerving Gaze for 24 hours. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Mushroom Portal
entries.description: Passive: The chamberlain counts as a mushroom for the Fungus Stride feature of the bridesmaid of Zuggtmoy.

entries.name: Poison Spores
entries.description: Reaction: Whenever the chamberlain takes damage, it releases a cloud of spores. Creatures within Melee range of the chamberlain when this happens must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be poisoned for 1 minute. A creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on a success.

entries.name: Infestation Spores
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The chamberlain releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a sphere (Very Close range) centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failure, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

If the spell is 5th level or higher, Charmayne makes an Intelligence check (Difficulty 10 + the spell's level). On a success, the spell fails and has no effect. Whatever the spell's level, the caster takes 3d6 magic damage (fire) if the spell fails. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

The target succeeds automatically after 10 minutes or if it takes damage or a creature within Melee range of it takes an action to empty a flask of Holy Water on it. entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Reaction: Chief Kartha-Kaya attempts to magically possess a humanoid or giant. Chief Kartha-Kaya must touch the target throughout a short rest, or the attempt fails. At the end of the rest, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be possessed by Chief Kartha-Kaya, which disappears with everything it is carrying and wearing. Until the possession ends, the target is incapacitated, loses control of its body, and is unaware of its surroundings. Chief Kartha-Kaya now controls the body and can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment; its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and its proficiencies. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, except the target's knowledge, class features, feats, and proficiencies. The possession lasts until either the body drops to 0 HP, Chief Kartha-Kaya ends the possession as an action, or Chief Kartha-Kaya is forced out of the body by an effect such as the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Chief Kartha-Kaya reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body and is stunned until the end of its next turn. If the host body dies while it is possessed by Chief Kartha-Kaya, Chief Kartha-Kaya dies as well, and its body doesn't reappear.

A swallowed creature is blinded and restrained, has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Very Close range of the worm. If the worm dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using Close range of movement, exiting prone.

These remains have total cover against attacks and other effects outside the corpse flower. If the corpse flower dies, the corpses within it can be pulled free.

entries.name: Stench of Death

On a failure, the creature is poisoned until the start of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature is immune to the Stench of Death of all corpse flowers for 24 hours.

The zombie appears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the corpse flower and acts immediately after it in the initiative order. The zombie acts as an ally of the corpse flower but isn't under its control, and the flower's stench clings to it (see Stench of Death).

entries.name: Aversion of Fire
entries.description: Passive: If the golem takes fire damage, it has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Berserk
entries.description: Passive: Whenever the golem starts its turn with 40 HP or fewer, roll a d6. On a 6, the golem goes berserk. On each of its turns while berserk, the golem attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the golem attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the golem goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. The golem's creator, if within Far range of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The golem must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a Presence Roll (15). If the check succeeds, the golem ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 HP or fewer, the golem might go berserk again.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: Passive: The golem is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Lightning Absorption
entries.description: Passive: Whenever the golem is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The golem has advantage on Reaction Rolls against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Magic Weapons
entries.description: Passive: The golem's weapon attacks are magical.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

name: Dancing Flame

entries.name: Flame
entries.description: Passive: The flame sheds bright light in a radius (Close range) and dim light for an additional Close range. If it leaves the hall or is reduced to 0 HP, it is destroyed and can't re-form for 24 hours.

entries.name: Telepathic Bond
entries.description: Reaction: The flame ignores the range restriction on its telepathy when communicating with a creature it has charmed. The two don't even need to be on the same plane of existence.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 magic damage (fire).

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One humanoid the flame can see within Close range of it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be magically charmed for 1 day. The charmed target obeys the flame's verbal or telepathic commands. If the target suffers any harm or receives a suicidal command, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on a success. If the target successfully saves against the effect, or if the effect on it ends, the target is immune to this flame's Charm for the next 24 hours. The flame can have only one target charmed at a time. If it charms another, the effect on the previous target ends.

entries.name: Draining Kiss
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The flame kisses a creature charmed by it or a willing creature. The target must make a Strength Reaction Roll against this magic, taking 5d10+5 magic damage (psychic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. The target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: Danika can use its action to polymorph into a raven-humanoid hybrid or into a raven, or back into its human form. Its statistics, other than its size, are the same in each form. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying isn't transformed. It reverts to its human form if it dies.

entries.name: Mimicry
entries.description: Passive: Danika can mimic simple sounds it has heard, such as a person whispering, a baby crying, or an animal chittering. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful Instinct Roll (10).

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Danika regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If Danika takes damage from a silvered weapon or a spell, this trait doesn't function at the start of Danika's next turn. Danika dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.description: Passive: The dao can burrow through non-magical, unworked earth and stone. While doing so, the dao doesn't disturb the material it moves through.

entries.name: Elemental Restoration
entries.description: Passive: If the dao dies outside the Elemental Plane of Earth, its body dissolves into dirt, and it gains a new body in 1d4 days, reviving with all its HP somewhere on the Plane of Earth.

entries.name: Magic Resistance
entries.description: Passive: The dao has Advantage on Reaction Rolls against spells and other magical effects.

entries.name: Wishes
entries.description: Passive: The dao has a 30 percent chance of knowing the Wish spell. If the dao knows it, the dao can cast it only on behalf of a non-genie creature who communicates a wish in a way the dao can understand. If the dao casts the spell for the creature, the dao suffers none of the spell's stress. Once the dao has cast it three times, the dao can't do so again for 365 days.

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: As the Lord Protector of Triboar and a secret agent of the Harpers, Darathra has sworn an oath to defend the town. She takes her duty very seriously. In addition to her gear, Darathra has an unarmored warhorse named Buster. Ideal: "Good people should be given every chance to prosper, free of tyranny." Bond: "I'll lay down my life to protect Triboar and its citizens." Flaw: "I refuse to back down. Push me, and I'll push back."

name: Dark Tide Knight

entries.name: Bonded Mount
entries.description: Passive: The knight is magically bound to a beast with an innate swimming speed trained to serve as its mount. While mounted on this beast, the knight gains the beast's senses and ability to breathe underwater. The bonded mount obeys the knight's commands. If its mount dies, the knight can train a new beast to serve as its bonded mount, a process requiring a month.

Any creature in that area must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be blinded until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Light Sensitivity
entries.description: Passive: While in bright light, the darkling has disadvantage on attacks, as well as on Wisdom (Perception) checks that rely on sight.

Any creature in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 2d6 magic damage (radiant) and is blinded until the end of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage and isn't blinded.

name: Darkmantle

entries.name: Crush
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage. The darkmantle attaches to the target. If the target is a Medium or smaller creature and the darkmantle had Advantage on the attack, it covers the target, which has the Blinded condition and is suffocating while the darkmantle is attached in this way. While attached to a target, the darkmantle can attack only the target but has Advantage on its attacks. Its Speed becomes 0, it can't benefit from any bonus to its Speed, and it moves with the target.A creature can take an action to try to detach the darkmantle from itself, doing so with a successful Strength Roll (13). On its turn, the darkmantle can detach itself by using Melee range of movement.

entries.name: Darkness Aura
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Magical Darkness fills a Emanation (Close range) originating from the darkmantle. This effect lasts while the darkmantle maintains Concentration on it, up to 10 minutes. Darkvision can't penetrate this area, and no light can illuminate it.

If the target is a creature, the target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Shadow Web
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target. On a success, deal 3d10 magic damage (necrotic). The target has the Restrained condition. The shadow web can be attacked and destroyed (Difficulty 16; 20 HP; vulnerability to radiant damage; immunity to bludgeoning, necrotic, poison, and psychic damage). The darkweaver can grapple up to six creatures at a time using its shadow web.

entries.name: Reel
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The darkweaver pulls each creature it has grappled up to Far range toward itself.

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: In his youth, Darz was a member of the Xanathar Thieves' Guild in Waterdeep. After serving ten years in prison for his crimes, he cut all ties to the city and moved north to be a campground caretaker. Ideal: "You can run from your past, but you can't hide from it." Bond: "I've made a new life in Triboar. I'm not gonna run away this time. " Flaw: "I have no regrets. I do whatever it takes to survive."

entries.name: Gaze
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Demogorgon turns his magical gaze toward one creature he can see within Far range of him. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or suffer one of the following effects (choose one or roll a d6):1–2: Beguiling Gaze. The target is stunned until the start of Demogorgon's next turn or until Demogorgon is no longer within line of sight.3–4: Confusing Gaze. The target suffers the effect of the confusion spell without making a Reaction Roll. The effect lasts until the start of Demogorgon's next turn. Demogorgon doesn't need to concentrate on the spell.5–6: Hypnotic Gaze. The target is charmed by Demogorgon until the start of Demogorgon's next turn. Demogorgon chooses how the charmed target uses its action, reaction, and movement.

That creature is teleported inside the devourer's ribcage and imprisoned there. While imprisoned in this way, the creature is restrained and has disadvantage on death Reaction Rolls. If the creature dies while imprisoned, the devourer regains 25 HP and immediately recharges Soul Rend. Additionally, at the start of its next turn, the devourer regurgitates the slain creature and the creature becomes an undead. If the victim had 2 or fewer Hit Dice, it becomes a zombie. If it had 3 to 5 Hit Dice, it becomes a ghoul. Otherwise, it becomes a wight. A devourer can imprison only one creature at a time.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d6+4 physical damage plus 6d6 magic damage (necrotic). If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be cursed with mummy rot. The cursed target can't regain HP, and its HP maximum decreases by 3d6 for every 24 hours that elapse. If the curse reduces the target's HP maximum to 0, the target dies, and its body turns to dust. The curse lasts until removed by the remove curse spell or other magic.

entries.name: Dreadful Glare
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Diderius targets one creature it can see within Far range of it. If the target can see Diderius, it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll against this magic or become frightened until the end of the mummy's next turn. If the target fails the Reaction Roll by 5 or more, it is also paralyzed for the same duration. A target that succeeds on the Reaction Roll is immune to the Dreadful Glare of all mummies and mummy lords for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Blinding Dust
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Blinding dust and sand swirls magically around Diderius. Each creature within Melee range of Diderius must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be blinded until the end of the creature's next turn.

entries.name: Blasphemous Word
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Diderius utters a blasphemous word. Each non-undead creature within Very Close range of Diderius that can hear the magical utterance must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be stunned until the end of Diderius's next turn.

entries.name: Channel Negative Energy
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Diderius magically unleashes negative energy. Creatures within Far range of Diderius, including ones behind barriers and around corners, can't regain HP until the end of Diderius's next turn.

entries.name: Whirlwind of Sand
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Diderius magically transforms into a whirlwind of sand, moves up to Far range, and reverts to its normal form. While in whirlwind form, Diderius is immune to all damage, and it can't be grappled, petrified, knocked prone (Vulnerable), restrained, or stunned. Equipment worn or carried by Diderius remain in its possession.

entries.name: False Appearance (Object Form Only)

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The shard disappears as it pours its psychic essence into a Medium or smaller nonsentient object it can see within Close range of it, magically possessing it. The object uses the shard's Difficulty, and any damage dealt to the object applies to the shard's HP. The shard inhabits the object until it uses an action to leave; until it is turned; until it is reduced to 0 HP; or until an effect that ends possession, such as a dispel evil and good spell, is used on it. When it leaves the object, it reappears in the nearest unoccupied space. While inhabited, the object becomes a magic item if it wasn't already, and a Tiny cracked gemstone matching the kind of gem dragon the shard was in life appears somewhere on the object. The shard can cause the object to fly using the shard's own flying speed, use its senses, speak verbally or telepathically, cast spells, and use its legendary actions. If a creature wears or carries the inhabited object, the shard can grant the creature the following benefits:Each of the creature's attacks deals an extra 1d8 force damage on a hit. The creature gains resistance to psychic damage.

While enlarged, the duergar is Large, doubles its damage dice on Strength-based weapon attacks (included in the attacks), and makes Strength checks and Strength Reaction Rolls with advantage. If the duergar lacks the room to become Large, it attains the maximum size possible in the space available.

entries.name: Headless Summoning
entries.description: Action: If the dullahan is reduced to 0 HP, it doesn't die or fall unconscious. Instead, it regains 97 HP. In addition, it summons three death's heads, one of each type, in unoccupied spaces within Melee range of it. The death's heads are under the dullahan's control and act immediately after the dullahan in the initiative order. Additionally, the dullahan can now use the options in the "Mythic Actions" section. Award a party an additional 5,900 XP (11,800 XP total) for defeating the dullahan after it uses Headless Summoning.

If the dullahan scores a critical hit against a creature, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or the dullahan cuts off the target's head. The target dies if it can't survive without the lost head. A creature that doesn't have or need a head, or has legendary actions, instead takes an extra .

entries.name: Fiery Skull
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+3 magic damage (fire).

entries.name: Frightful Presence
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Each creature of the dullahan's choice within Close range of it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become frightened of the dullahan until the end of its next turn.

entries.name: Spell Turning
entries.description: Passive: While wearing his ring of spell turning, Durnan has advantage on Reaction Rolls against any spell that targets only him (not in an area of effect). If Durnan rolls a 20 for the Reaction Roll and the spell is 7th level or lower, the spell has no effect on him and instead targets the caster, using the slot level, the caster's Difficulty, attack bonus, and spellcasting ability of the caster.

If the target is an object, the hit instead deals . If the target is a creature and Durnan rolls a 20 on the d20 for the attack, the target takes an extra , and Durnan rolls another d20. On a roll of 20, he lops off one of the target's limbs, or some other part of its body if it is limbless.

An animated tree acts as an ally of Duskwalker. The tree remains animate for 1 day or until it dies; until Duskwalker dies or is more than Far range from the tree; or until Duskwalker takes its action to turn it back into an inanimate tree. The tree then takes root if possible.

name: Dust Hulk

entries.name: Air Form
entries.description: Passive: The dust hulk can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. It can move through a space as narrow as 1 inch without squeezing.

entries.name: Death Burst
entries.description: Reaction: When the dust hulk dies, it explodes in a burst of dust that fills a sphere (Very Close range) centered on itself. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or have the blinded condition for 1 minute. An affected creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

On a failure, the creature takes 3d6 physical damage and has the blinded condition until the end of its next turn. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage only.

name: Duvessa Shane

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: The daughter of a Waterdhavian trader and a tavern server, Duvessa has her mother's talent for negotiation and her father's charm. As the first woman to serve as Town Speaker of Bryn Shander, and a young one at that, she has much to prove. Ideal: "The people of Icewind Dale are survivors. They can weather any storm." Bond: "My mother taught me what it means to be a good leader. I won't disappoint her." Flaw: "I don't give an inch in any argument of conflict."

If the target is a creature, its HP maximum is also reduced by 1d6. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a short or long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Possess Corpse
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The dybbuk disappears into an intact corpse within Melee range of it that belonged to a Large or smaller Beast or Humanoid. The dybbuk gains 20 temporary HP. While possessing the corpse, the dybbuk adopts the corpse's size and can't use Incorporeal Movement. Its game statistics otherwise remain the same. The possession lasts until the temporary HP are lost or the dybbuk ends it . When the possession ends, the dybbuk appears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the corpse.

entries.name: Control Corpse
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. While Possess Corpse is active, the dybbuk makes the corpse do something unnatural, such as vomit blood, twist its head all the way around, or cause a quadruped to move as a biped. Any Beast or Humanoid that sees this behavior must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become frightened of the dybbuk for 1 minute. The frightened creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. A creature that succeeds on a Reaction Roll against this ability is immune to Control Corpse for 24 hours.

Dyrrn can't use the same tentacle whip on another target until this grapple ends. Dyrrn has two tentacle whips.

The creature has disadvantage on attacks, its speed is reduced by half, and if it tries to cast a spell, it must first succeed on a Knowledge Roll (15) or the spell fails and is wasted. entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within Far range of Ebondeath that can see it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this Ebondeath's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One humanoid that Ebondeath can see within Melee range of it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by Ebondeath; Ebondeath then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Ebondeath now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Ebondeath can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, including gaining access to the target's knowledge, class features, and proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Ebondeath ends it or Ebondeath is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Ebondeath reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. The target is immune to Ebondeath Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Non-magical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Creatures of the elder brain's choice within Far range of it must succeed on a Knowledge Reaction Roll or take 5d10+5 magic damage (psychic) and be stunned for 1 minute. A target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Psychic Link
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The elder brain targets one incapacitated creature it senses with its Creature Sense trait and establishes a psychic link with the target. Until the link ends, the elder brain can perceive everything the target senses. The target becomes aware that something is linked to its mind once it is no longer incapacitated, and the elder brain can terminate the link at any time (no action required). The target can use an action on its turn to attempt to break the link, doing so with a successful Presence Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the target takes 3d6 magic damage (psychic). The link also ends if the target and the elder brain are more than 5 miles apart. The elder brain can form psychic links with up to ten creatures at a time.

entries.name: Sense Thoughts
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The elder brain targets a creature with which it has a psychic link. The elder brain gains insight into the target's emotional state and foremost thoughts (including worries, loves, and hates).

entries.name: Break Concentration
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The elder brain targets one creature within Far range of it with which it has a psychic link. The elder brain breaks the creature's concentration on a spell it has cast. The creature also takes 1d4 magic damage (psychic) per level of the spell.

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The elder brain targets one creature within Far range of it with which it has a psychic link. The target and enemies of the elder brain within Close range of target take 3d6 magic damage (psychic).

entries.name: Sever Psychic Link

The elder brain ends the link, causing the creature to have disadvantage on all ability checks, attacks, and Reaction Rolls until the end of the creature's next turn.

entries.name: Tadpole Brine Breath
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The dragon exhales brine in a line (Far range) that is 15 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 10d10 magic damage (psychic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. On a success or failure, if the creature isn't a Construct or an Undead, it becomes infested with illithid tadpoles. While infested, the creature takes 3d10 magic damage (psychic) at the start of each of its turns. The creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself after it succeeds on three of these Reaction Rolls. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a curse or restores 40 HP or more, the tadpoles infesting the creature are killed instantly, ending the effect on the creature. If a Humanoid is reduced to 0 HP while infested, the creature is stable but remains unconscious for 6d12 hours. When the period of unconsciousness ends, the creature transforms into a mind flayer (see the Monster Manual) with all its HP. Casting a wish spell on the unconscious creature rids it of the infestation and prevents it from turning into a mind flayer.

Constructs, Oozes, Plants, and Undead succeed on the Reaction Roll automatically. While memory drained, the target must roll a d4 and subtract the number rolled from any ability check or attack it makes. Each time the target is memory drained beyond the first, the die size increases by one: the d4 becomes a d6, the d6 becomes a d8, and so on until the die becomes a d20, at which point the target becomes unconscious for 1 hour. The effect then ends. The oblex learns all the languages a memory-drained target knows and gains all its skill proficiencies.

entries.name: Sulfurous Impersonation
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The oblex extrudes a piece of itself that assumes the appearance of one Medium or smaller creature whose memories it has stolen. This simulacrum appears, feels, and sounds exactly like the creature it impersonates, though it smells faintly of sulfur. The oblex can impersonate 2d6 + 1 different creatures, each one tethered to its body by a strand of slime that can extend up to Far range away. The simulacrum is an extension of the oblex, meaning that the oblex occupies its space and the simulacrum's space simultaneously. The tether is immune to damage, but it is severed if there is no opening at least 1 inch wide between the oblex and the simulacrum. The simulacrum disappears if the tether is severed.

entries.name: Instinctive Charm

On a failure, the attacker redirects the attack to the creature closest to it, other than the enchanter or itself. If multiple eligible creatures are closest, the attacker chooses which one to target. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or have the stunned condition due to fear or delight (the infiltrator's choice) until the end of the target's next turn, after which the target is immune to this Beguiling Whisper for 24 hours.

entries.name: Cunning
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The infiltrator escapes non-magical restraints and ends the Restrained condition on itself, then moves up to its speed without provoking opportunity attacks.

entries.name: Misdirecting Escape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The infiltrator magically has the invisible condition and creates an illusory duplicate of itself in its space, then teleports, along with any equipment it is wearing or carrying, to an unoccupied space within Close range of itself. The image flings illusory blades at two creatures of the infiltrator's choice within Close range of the image. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll, taking 3d8 magic damage (psychic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. The invisibility lasts until the end of the infiltrator's next turn.

entries.name: Uncanny Dodge
entries.description: Reaction: When an attacker the infiltrator can see hits the infiltrator with an attack, the infiltrator halves the attack's damage against it. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Boon of Immortality
entries.description: Passive: Endelyn is immune to any effect that would age her, and she can't die from old age.

entries.name: Eclipsed Doom
entries.description: Reaction: Endelyn can be killed only if she is reduced to 0 HP during a solar eclipse or while she is within Far range of a symbolic representation of one. Otherwise, Endelyn disappears in a cloud of inky smoke when she drops to 0 HP, along with anything she was wearing or carrying, and reappears 24 hours later in the same location or the nearest unoccupied space.
