entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The centipede makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller creature it is grappling. If the attack hits, that creature takes the bite's damage and is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the centipede, and it takes 6d6 magic damage (acid) at the start of each of the centipede's turns. If the centipede takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the centipede must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Very Close range of the centipede. If the centipede dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using Close range of movement, exiting prone.

entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Ogrémoch's crystalline protrusions flare. Each creature within Close range of Ogrémoch becomes outlined in orange light, shedding dim light in a radius (Very Close range). Any attack against an affected creature has advantage if the attacker can see it, and the affected creature can't benefit from being invisible.

entries.name: Create Gargoyle
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Ogrémoch's HP are reduced by 50 as he breaks off a chunk of his body and places it on the ground in an unoccupied space within Close range of him. The chunk of rock instantly transforms into a gargoyle and acts on the same initiative count as Ogrémoch. Ogrémoch can't use this action if he has 50 HP or fewer. The gargoyle obeys Ogrémoch's commands and fights until destroyed.

In addition, the oinoloth can end one disease on the target or remove one of the following conditions from it: blinded, deafened, paralyzed, or poisoned. The target then gains 1 level of exhaustion, and its HP maximum is reduced by 2d6. This reduction can be removed only by a wish spell or by casting greater restoration on the target three times within the same hour. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Bringer of Plagues
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The oinoloth blights the area in a sphere (Close range) centered on itself. The blight lasts for 24 hours. While the area is blighted, all normal plants there wither and die. Furthermore, when a creature moves into the blighted area or starts its turn there, that creature must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 4d6 magic damage (poison) and is poisoned. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature is immune to the oinoloth's Bringer of Plagues for the next 24 hours. The poisoned creature can't regain HP. After every 24 hours that elapse, the poisoned creature can repeat the Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature's HP maximum is reduced by 1d10. This reduction lasts until the poison ends, and the target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0. The poison ends after the creature successfully saves against it three times.

If the attack hits, the target is swallowed, and the grapple ends. The swallowed target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Old Croaker, and it takes 3d6 magic damage (acid) at the start of each of Old Croaker's turns. Old Croaker can have only one target swallowed at a time. If Old Croaker dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using Melee range of movement, exiting prone.

The target also suffers one of the following effects of the orthon's choice; the orthon can't use the same effect two rounds in a row:Acid. The target must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking an additional on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. Blindness. The target takes . In addition, the target and all other creatures within Close range of it must each make a successful Agility Reaction Roll or be blinded until the end of the orthon's next turn. Concussion. The target and each creature within Close range of it must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. Entanglement. The target must make a successful Agility Reaction Roll or be restrained for 1 hour by strands of sticky webbing. The target can escape by taking an action to make a Difficulty 17 Strength or Dexterity check and succeeding. Paralysis. The target takes and must make a successful Strength Reaction Roll or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The paralyzed target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. Tracking. For the next 24 hours, the orthon knows the direction and distance to the target, as long as it's on the same plane of existence. If the target is on a different plane, the orthon knows which one, but not the exact location there.

entries.name: Swallow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The behir makes one bite attack against a Medium or smaller target it is grappling. If the attack hits, the target is also swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the target is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the behir, and it takes 6d6 magic damage (acid) at the start of each of the behir's turns. A behir can have only one creature swallowed at a time. Any creature swallowed by a parasite-infested behir must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the start of each of the behir's turns or be feasted upon by blood parasites, taking 8d8 magic damage (necrotic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful Reaction Roll. This damage is in addition to the damage caused by the behir's digestive acids. If the behir takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the behir must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Very Close range of the behir. If the behir dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse by using Close range of movement, exiting prone.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One Large or smaller creature Grappled by the worm (it can have up to three creatures swallowed at a time) must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure: The target is swallowed by the worm, and the Restrained condition ends. A swallowed creature has the Blinded and Restrained conditions, has Total Cover against attacks and other effects outside the worm, and takes 5d6 magic damage (acid) at the start of each of the worm's turns. If the worm takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the worm must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within Melee range of the worm and is knocked prone (Vulnerable). If the worm dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse using Close range of movement, exiting Prone.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The drone launches a tiny orb of magical force at a creature it can see within Close range of itself. The creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be encased in the orb, which expands to a size just large enough to contain the creature. While encased, the creature doesn't need to breathe, eat, or drink, and it doesn't age. Nothing can pass through the orb, nor can any creature teleport or use planar travel to enter or exit the orb. The drone can move the orb and its contents up to Close range in any direction. A successful casting of the Dispel Magic spell on the orb (Difficulty 15) destroys it. The orb otherwise remains intact until the drone spends an action to end the effect or the drone is destroyed. A drone can have only one detention orb active at a time; if the drone creates a detention orb when it already has one active, the first orb disappears, freeing the creature inside.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Rak Tulkhesh magically polymorphs into a humanoid, beast, or giant that has a challenge rating no higher than his own, or back into his true form. He reverts to his true form if he dies. Any equipment he is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (his choice). In a new form, Rak Tulkhesh retains his alignment, HP, Hit Dice, ability to speak, proficiencies, Legendary Resistance, and Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores, as well as this action. His statistics and capabilities are otherwise replaced by those of the new form, except any class features or legendary actions of that form.

entries.name: End Magic

entries.name: Provoke Rage
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Each creature within Far range of Rak Tulkhesh must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or use its reaction to make a melee weapon attack against a random creature within reach. If no creatures are within reach, it makes a ranged weapon attack against a random creature within range, throwing its weapon if necessary. This attack is made with advantage and gains a +4 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Captivating Presence
entries.description: Passive: Any creature that starts its turn within Close range of Rakdos must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature becomes charmed by Rakdos for 1 minute or until the creature is farther than Close range away from him. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature becomes immune to Rakdos's Captivating Presence for 24 hours.

entries.name: Cruel Entertainment
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature Rakdos can see within Far range of him is reduced to 0 HP, Rakdos gains 25 temporary HP.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting

entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

The poisoned creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Eye Rays
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The beholder shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within Far range of it:1. Charm Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be charmed by the beholder for 1 hour, or until the beholder harms the creature.2. Paralyzing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.3. Fear Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.4. Slowing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or its action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.5. Enervation Ray. The targeted creature must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 8d8 magic damage (necrotic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.6. Telekinetic Ray. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or the beholder moves it up to Close range in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of the beholder's next turn or until the beholder is incapacitated. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to Close range in any direction. The beholder can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.7. Sleep Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.8. Petrification Ray. The targeted creature must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.9. Disintegration Ray. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 10d8 magic damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust. If the target is a Large or smaller non-magical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a Reaction Roll. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a cube (Very Close range) of it.10. Death Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 10d10 magic damage (necrotic). The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 HP.

If its penalty drops to −5, the weapon is destroyed. Non-magical ammunition made of metal or wood that hits the pudding is destroyed after dealing damage. The pudding can eat through 2-inch-thick, non-magical wood or metal in 1 round.

The armor is destroyed if the penalty reduces its Difficulty to 10.

Each new pudding has HP equal to half the original pudding's, rounded down. New puddings are one size smaller than the original pudding. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Rerak targets one creature it can see within Far range of itself. The target must make a Presence Reaction Roll; if the target has the unconscious condition, it has disadvantage on this Reaction Roll. The target takes 6d6 magic damage on a failure or half as much damage on a successful one. Rerak then regains a number of HP equal to the amount of force damage taken. If this damage reduces the target to 0 HP, the target immediately dies, its body disappears, and its soul is trapped inside one of the soul gems within Rerak's skull. After 24 hours, the gem transfers the soul to Rerak's creator. When Rerak is reduced to 0 HP, it is destroyed and disintegrates, leaving behind the gems. Crushing a gem releases any souls trapped within, at which point the soul's body re-forms in an unoccupied space nearest to the gem and in the same state as it was when its soul was trapped.

The retriever also always knows the location of its master.

entries.name: Horrifying Visage
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Each non-undead creature within Far range of Rilago that can see it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the target also ages 1d4 × 10 years. A frightened target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the frightened condition on itself on a success. If a target's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, the target is immune to this ghost's Horrifying Visage for the next 24 hours. The aging effect can be reversed with a greater restoration spell, but only within 24 hours of it occurring.

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One humanoid that Rilago can see within Melee range of it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by Rilago; Rilago then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Rilago now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Rilago can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Rilago ends it or Rilago is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Rilago reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

entries.name: Whirlpool
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The wave shaper targets a body of water at least Far range square and 25 feet deep, causing a whirlpool to form in the center of the area. The whirlpool forms a vortex that is 5 feet wide at the base, up to Far range wide at the top, 25 feet tall, and lasts for 1 minute or until the wave shaper is incapacitated. Any creature or object in the water and within Close range of the vortex is pulled Very Close range toward it. A creature can swim away from the vortex by succeeding on a Strength Roll (14). When a creature enters the vortex for the first time on a turn or starts its turn there, it must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 2d8 physical damage and is caught in the vortex until it ends. On a success, the creature takes half damage and isn't caught in the vortex. A creature caught in the vortex can use its action to try to swim away from the vortex as described above, but it has disadvantage on the Strength (Athletics) check to do so. The first time each turn that an object enters the vortex, the object takes 2d8 physical damage. This damage occurs each round it remains in the vortex.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If Sandesyl isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to polymorph into a Tiny bat or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into its true form. While in bat form, Sandesyl can't speak, its walking speed is Melee range, and it has a flying speed of Close range. Its statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies. While in mist form, Sandesyl can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. It is weightless, has a flying speed of Close range, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and it can't pass through water. It has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Strength Reaction Rolls, and it is immune to all non-magical damage, except the damage it takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description: Reaction: When it drops to 0 HP outside its resting place, Sandesyl transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that it isn't in sunlight or running water. If it can't transform, it is destroyed. While it has 0 HP in mist form, it can't revert to its vampire form, and it must reach its resting place within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in its resting place, it reverts to its vampire form. It is then paralyzed until it regains at least 1 HP. After spending 1 hour in its resting place with 0 HP, it regains 1 HP.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Sandesyl regains 20 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight or running water. If Sandesyl takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of Sandesyl's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses

Sandesyl takes 20 acid damage if it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into Sandesyl's heart while Sandesyl is incapacitated in its resting place, Sandesyl is paralyzed until the stake is removed. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. Sandesyl takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+4 physical damage plus 3d6 magic damage (necrotic). The target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Sandesyl regains HP equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if this effect reduces its HP maximum to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Sandesyl's control.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Sandesyl targets one humanoid it can see within Close range of it. If the target can see Sandesyl, the target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll against this magic or be charmed by Sandesyl. The charmed target regards Sandesyl as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. Although the target isn't under Sandesyl's control, it takes Sandesyl's requests or actions in the most favorable way it can, and it is a willing target for Sandesyl's bite attack. Each time Sandesyl or Sandesyl's companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Sandesyl is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes its action to end the effect.

The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Sandesyl dies, or until Sandesyl dismisses them .

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: As a knight of the Order of the Gauntlet, Sir Baric has sworn oaths to catch evildoers and bring them to justice. His current quarry is a dwarf brigand, Worvil "the Weevil" Forkbeard, who is rumored to be hiding in Icewind Dale. In addition to his gear, Sir Baric has an unarmored warhorse, Henry. Ideal: "Evil must not be allowed to thrive in this world." Bond: "Tyr is my lord; the order, my family. Through my actions, I shall honor both." Flaw: "I'm not afraid to die. When Tyr finally calls me, I'll go to him happily."

While the soul is bodiless, a wish spell can be used to force the soul to go to the afterlife and not return.

Bond: "Icewind Dale is where i belong for the rest of my life." Flaw: "I am honest to a fault."

entries.description: Action: Slarkrethel ignores difficult terrain, and magical effects can't reduce its speed or cause it to be restrained. It can spend Melee range of movement to escape from non-magical restraints or being grappled.

entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 3d8+10 physical damage plus 12d6 magic damage (acid). If the target is a Large or smaller creature grappled by Slarkrethel, that creature is swallowed, and the grapple ends. While swallowed, the creature is blinded and restrained, it has total cover against attacks and other effects outside Slarkrethel, and it takes at the start of each of Slarkrethel's turns. If Slarkrethel takes 50 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, Slarkrethel must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, which fall prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Very Close range of Slarkrethel. If Slarkrethel dies, a swallowed creature is no longer restrained by it and can escape from the corpse using Close range of movement, exiting prone.

entries.name: Tentacle
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 3d6+10 physical damage. The target is Restrained. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained. Slarkrethel has ten tentacles, each of which can grapple one target.

entries.name: Fling
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One Large or smaller object held or creature grappled by Slarkrethel is thrown up to Far range in a random direction and knocked prone (Vulnerable). If a thrown target strikes a solid surface, the target takes 1d6 physical damage for every Very Close range it was thrown. If the target is thrown at another creature, that creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take the same damage and be knocked prone (Vulnerable).

entries.name: Lightning Storm
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Slarkrethel magically creates three bolts of lightning, each of which can strike a target Slarkrethel can see within Far range of it. A target must make an Agility Reaction Roll, taking 4d10 magic damage (lightning) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Lightning Storm
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Slarkrethel uses Lightning Storm.

entries.name: Ink Cloud
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. While underwater, Slarkrethel expels an ink cloud in a radius (Far range). The cloud spreads around corners, and that area is heavily obscured to creatures other than Slarkrethel. Each creature other than Slarkrethel that ends its turn there must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 3d10 magic damage (poison) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one. A strong current disperses the cloud, which otherwise disappears at the end of Slarkrethel's next turn.

entries.description: Reaction: When the bloodfin dies, it explodes in a cloud of toxic blood. Each creature in a sphere (Very Close range) centered on the exploding bloodfin, including any creature swallowed by the bloodfin, must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or take 3d6 magic damage (poison). A creature inside the bloodfin when it explodes falls prone (Vulnerable) in the space formerly occupied by the bloodfin and is no longer blinded or restrained by it.

entries.name: Water Breathing
entries.description: Passive: The bloodfin can breathe only underwater.

entries.name: Swallow
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d6 magic damage (necrotic). The bloodfin swallows the target. The swallowed creature is no longer grappled but is blinded and restrained. It has total cover against attacks and other effects outside the bloodfin, it takes at the start of each of its turns, and the bloodfin regains HP equal to the necrotic damage dealt. A bloodfin can have only one creature swallowed at a time. If the bloodfin takes 30 damage or more on a single turn from the swallowed creature, the bloodfin must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll at the end of that turn or regurgitate the creature, which falls prone (Vulnerable) in a space within Melee range of the bloodfin and is no longer blinded or restrained by it.

name: Slithering Tracker

entries.name: False Appearance
entries.description: Passive: If the slithering tracker is motionless at the start of combat, it has advantage on its initiative roll. Moreover, if a creature hasn't observed the slithering tracker move or act, that creature must succeed on a Knowledge Roll (18) to discern that the slithering tracker isn't a puddle.

entries.name: Liquid Form
entries.description: Passive: The slithering tracker can enter an enemy's space and stop there. It can also move through a space as narrow as 1 inch wide without squeezing.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: The slithering tracker can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Slam
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d10+3 physical damage.

entries.name: Life Leech
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. One Large or smaller creature that the slithering tracker can see within Melee range of it must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be grappled. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained and unable to breathe unless it can breathe water. In addition, the grappled target takes 3d10 magic damage (necrotic) at the start of each of its turns. The slithering tracker can grapple only one target at a time. While grappling the target, the slithering tracker takes only half any damage dealt to it (rounded down), and the target takes the other half.

entries.name: Watery Stealth
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. If underwater, the slithering tracker becomes Hidden, and it makes the Dexterity (Stealth) check with advantage.

entries.name: Spectral Touch
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 3d8+7 magic damage plus 3d6 magic damage (necrotic). If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll, or its HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken. This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.A Humanoid slain by this attack immediately rises as a miniature spectral cloud (use the specter stat block in the Monster Manual). The miniature spectral cloud acts as an ally of its creator but isn't under its control.

entries.name: Chilling Winds
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The spectral cloud emits intensely cold wind in a line (Far range) that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, a creature takes 7d10 magic damage (cold) and has the incapacitated condition for 1 minute. The affected creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half as much damage only. If a creature's Reaction Roll is successful or the effect ends for it, that creature is immune to this spectral cloud's Chilling Winds for the next 24 hours.

On each of its turns while berserk, the tomb guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the tomb guardian attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the tomb guardian goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. The golem's creator, if within Far range of the berserk tomb guardian, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The tomb guardian must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a Presence Roll (15). If the check succeeds, the tomb guardian ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 HP or fewer, the tomb guardian might go berserk again.

The apparition now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. The apparition can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, the apparition ends it the body leaves the Astral Plane, or the apparition is forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the apparition reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. If it reappears in a location not on the Astral Plane, the apparition is destroyed. The target is immune to this apparition's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

entries.name: Rock

entries.name: Lightning Strike
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The giant hurls a magical lightning bolt at a point it can see within Very Far range of it. Each creature within Very Close range of that point must make an Agility Reaction Roll, taking 12d8 magic damage (lightning) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.

entries.name: Alert
entries.description: Passive: The giant can't be surprised, and it has advantage on initiative rolls.

entries.name: Amphibious
entries.description: Passive: The giant can breathe air and water.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.name: Scrying (Requires Storm Rune)
entries.description: Passive: The giant can use its crystal ball to cast the scrying spell.

entries.name: Storm Rune
entries.description: Reaction: The giant has a storm rune inscribed on a crystal ball. While the object bearing the rune is embedded in its body, the giant can use its Tempest Call action and its Scrying trait. The object bearing the storm rune has Difficulty 17; 50 HP; and immunity to necrotic, poison, and psychic damage. The object regains all its HP at the end of every turn, but it turns to dust if reduced to 0 HP or when the giant dies. If the rune is destroyed, the giant can inscribe a storm rune on another crystal ball in its possession when it finishes a short or long rest.

On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half as much damage.

The herald can have only one creature grappled this way at a time.

entries.name: Psychic Wave
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The herald unleashes a blast of psionic energy into the minds of up to three creatures it can see within Far range of itself. Each target must make a Knowledge Reaction Roll. On a failure, a target takes 3d10+7 magic damage (psychic) and has the stunned condition for 1 minute. On a successful Reaction Roll, a target takes half as much damage only. An affected creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success. If a creature is reduced to 0 HP by this psychic damage, it dies and its head explodes if it has one.

entries.name: Loathsome Limbs
entries.description: Action: Whenever the zombie takes at least 5 bludgeoning or slashing damage at one time, roll a d20 to determine what else happens to it:1–8: One leg is severed from the zombie if it has any legs left.9–16: One arm is severed from the zombie if it has any arms left.17–20: The zombie is decapitated. If the zombie is reduced to 0 HP, all parts of it die. Until then, a severed part acts on the zombie's initiative and has its own action and movement. A severed part has Difficulty 8. Any damage it takes is subtracted from the zombie's HP.A severed leg is unable to attack and has a speed of Melee range.A severed arm has a speed of Melee range and can make one claw attack on its turn, with disadvantage on the attack. Each time the zombie loses an arm, it loses a claw attack. If its head is severed, the zombie loses its bite attack and its body is blinded unless the head can see it. The severed head has a speed of Melee range. It can make a bite attack, but only against a target in its space. The zombie's speed is halved if it's missing a leg. If it loses both legs, it falls prone (Vulnerable). If it has both arms, it can crawl. With only one arm, it can still crawl, but its speed is halved. With no arms or legs, its speed is Melee range, and it can't benefit from bonuses to speed.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d4+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Claw
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+1 physical damage.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If Strahd isn't in running water or sunlight, he can use his action to polymorph into a Tiny bat, a Medium wolf, or a Medium cloud of mist, or back into his true form. While in bat or wolf form, Strahd can't speak. In bat form, his walking speed is Melee range, and he has a flying speed of Close range. In wolf form, his walking speed is Far range. His statistics, other than his size and speed, are unchanged. Anything he is wearing transforms with him, but nothing he is carrying does. He reverts to his true form if he dies. While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects. He is weightless, has a flying speed of Close range, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. In addition, if air can pass through a space, the mist can do so without squeezing, and he can't pass through water. He has advantage on Strength, Dexterity, and Strength Reaction Rolls, and he is immune to all non-magical damage, except the damage he takes from sunlight.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.name: Misty Escape
entries.description: Reaction: When Strahd drops to 0 HP outside his coffin, he transforms into a cloud of mist (as in the Shapechanger trait) instead of falling unconscious, provided that he isn't in running water or sunlight. If he can't transform, he is destroyed. While he has 0 HP in mist form, he can't revert to his vampire form, and he must reach his coffin within 2 hours or be destroyed. Once in his coffin, he reverts to his vampire form. He is then paralyzed until he regains at least 1 HP. After 1 hour in his coffin with 0 HP, he regains 1 HP.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Strahd regains 20 HP at the start of his turn if he has at least 1 HP and isn't in running water or sunlight. If he takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of his next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: Strahd can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without having to make an ability check.

entries.description: Passive: Strahd has the following flaws:Forbiddance. He can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants. Harmed by Running Water. He takes 20 acid damage if he ends his turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. If a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into his heart while he is incapacitated in his coffin, he is paralyzed until the stake is removed. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, and he has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+4 physical damage plus 3d6 magic damage (necrotic). The target's HP maximum is reduced by an amount equal to the necrotic damage taken, and Strahd regains HP equal to that amount. The reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest. The target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0. A humanoid slain in this way and then buried in the ground rises the following night as a vampire spawn under Strahd's control.

entries.name: Charm
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Strahd targets one humanoid he can see within Close range of him. If the target can see Strahd, the target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll against this magic or be charmed. The charmed target regards Strahd as a trusted friend to be heeded and protected. The target isn't under Strahd's control, but it takes Strahd's requests and actions in the most favorable way and lets Strahd bite it. Each time Strahd or his companions do anything harmful to the target, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success. Otherwise, the effect lasts 24 hours or until Strahd is destroyed, is on a different plane of existence than the target, or takes its action to end the effect.

entries.name: Children of the Night
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Strahd magically calls 2d4 swarms of bats or swarms of rats, provided that the sun isn't up. While outdoors, Strahd can call 3d6 wolves instead. The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of Strahd and obeying his spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until Strahd dies, or until he dismisses them .

entries.name: Unarmed Strike
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Strahd makes one unarmed strike.

entries.name: Antimagic Susceptibility
entries.description: Passive: The armor is incapacitated while in the area of an antimagic field. If targeted by dispel magic, the armor must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll against the caster's Difficulty or fall unconscious for 1 minute.

entries.name: Constructed Nature
entries.description: Reaction: An animated object doesn't require air, food, drink, or sleep. The magic that animates an object is dispelled when the construct drops to 0 HP. An animated object reduced to 0 HP becomes inanimate and is too damaged to be of much use or value to anyone.

entries.name: False Appearance
entries.description: Passive: While the armor remains motionless, it is indistinguishable from a normal suit of armor.

entries.name: Shocking Bolt
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 3d6 magic damage (lightning).

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.description: Reaction: When Strahd is reduced to 0 HP, he dissolves into mist and immediately teleports to his lair in Castle Ravenloft. After 1d4 hours, Strahd re-forms in a random unoccupied space within his lair, regaining all his HP.

Sunlight Hypersensitivity. While in sunlight, Strahd takes 20 radiant damage at the start of his turn, has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks, and can't use his Change Shape bonus action.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Strahd transforms into a Tiny bat (flying speed Close range) or a Medium wolf (speed Far range). While in that form, he can't speak, and he retains his game statistics other than his size and speed.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Strahd transforms into a Medium cloud of mist. While in this form, Strahd has a flying speed of Close range, can hover, and can enter a hostile creature's space and stop there. While in mist form, Strahd can pass through a space without squeezing as long as air can pass through that space, but he can't pass through water. While in mist form, Strahd can't take any actions, speak, or manipulate objects.

The stirges are under the strigoi's control and act immediately after the strigoi in the initiative order. The stirges disappear after 1 hour, when the strigoi dies, or when the strigoi dismisses them (no action required).

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. One humanoid that Thorn can see within Melee range of it must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or be possessed by Thorn; Thorn then disappears, and the target is incapacitated and loses control of its body. Thorn now controls the body but doesn't deprive the target of awareness. Thorn can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, except ones that turn undead, and it retains its alignment, Intelligence, Wisdom, Charisma, and immunity to being charmed and frightened. It otherwise uses the possessed target's statistics, but doesn't gain access to the target's knowledge, class features, or proficiencies. The possession lasts until the body drops to 0 HP, Thorn ends it or Thorn is turned or forced out by an effect like the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, Thorn reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body. The target is immune to this ghost's Possession for 24 hours after succeeding on the Reaction Roll or after the possession ends.

Alternatively, he targets one creature charmed by him that is within Far range of him; that charmed target must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll, or Titivilus decides how the target acts during its next turn.

entries.name: Teleport
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Titivilus uses Teleport.

entries.name: Force Field
entries.description: Action: Tockworth generates a magical force field around herself. This force field has 15 HP and regains all its HP at the start of each of Tockworth's turns, but it ceases to function if Tockworth drops to 0 HP. Any damage Tockworth takes is subtracted from the force field's HP first. Each time the force field regains HP, the following conditions end on Tockworth: grappled, restrained, and stunned.

As long as the guardian and its amulet are on the same plane of existence, the amulet's wearer can telepathically call the guardian to travel to it, and the guardian knows the distance and direction to the amulet. If the guardian is within Far range of the amulet's wearer, half of any damage the wearer takes (rounded up) is transferred to the guardian.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: The shield guardian regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP.

entries.description: Reaction: When a creature makes an attack against the wearer of the guardian's amulet, the guardian grants a +2 bonus to the wearer's Difficulty if the guardian is within Melee range of the wearer. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Momentum
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

entries.name: Heavy Hitter
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary deals damage with a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to gain a +2 bonus to the damage roll.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. The tlacatecolo magically transforms into a Medium owl, while retaining its game statistics (other than its size). This transformation ends if the tlacatecolo is reduced to 0 HP or if it uses its action to end it.

entries.name: Plague Winds (Fiend Form Only)
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The tlacatecolo emits a chilling, disease-ridden wind in a line (Far range) that is 10 feet wide. Each creature in that area must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or take 4d12 magic damage (cold) and become poisoned. While poisoned in this way, the creature can't regain HP. At the end of every hour, the creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or gain 1 level of exhaustion. If the creature is in direct sunlight when it makes this Reaction Roll, it automatically succeeds on the Reaction Roll. If the creature is targeted by magic that ends a poison or disease, such as lesser restoration, while the creature isn't in direct sunlight, the effect does not end.

motives_tactics: Ambush, Strike from shadows, Escape when threatened, Corrupt

entries.name: Fire Aura
entries.description: Passive: At the start of each of the tlexolotl's turns, each creature within Very Close range of it takes 2d6 magic damage (fire), and flammable objects in that aura that aren't being worn or carried ignite. A creature that touches the tlexolotl or hits it with a melee attack while within Melee range of it takes 2d6 magic damage (fire).

entries.name: Illumination
entries.description: Passive: The tlexolotl sheds bright light in a radius (Close range) and dim light for an additional Close range.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: The tlexolotl regains 10 HP at the start of its turn. If the tlexolotl takes cold damage or is immersed in water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the tlexolotl's next turn. The tlexolotl dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Tail
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 1d8+7 physical damage plus 4d6 magic damage (fire). If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be pushed up to Very Close range away from the tlexolotl and knocked prone (Vulnerable).

entries.name: Pyroclasm
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Gouts of molten lava erupt from the tlexolotl's body. Each creature in a sphere (Close range) centered on the tlexolotl must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, a creature takes 6d6 magic damage (fire) and 6d6 physical damage. On a successful Reaction Roll, a creature takes half as much damage.

The target is Restrained if it is a Large or smaller creature. Until this grapple ends, the target is restrained, and the tlincalli can't use the spiked chain against another target.

entries.name: Sting
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d6+3 physical damage plus 4d6 magic damage (poison). The target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be poisoned for 1 minute. If it fails the Reaction Roll by 5 or more, the target is also paralyzed while poisoned. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.

entries.name: Shapechanger
entries.description: Passive: If the vampire isn't in sunlight or running water, it can use its action to Polymorph into a Tiny bat, or back into its true form. While in bat form, the vampire can't speak, its walking speed is Melee range, and it has a flying speed of Close range. Its Statistics, other than its size and speed, are unchanged. Anything it is wearing transforms with it, but nothing it is carrying does. It reverts to its true form if it dies.

entries.name: Innate Spellcasting
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to use this ability. Tloques can cast hold person (Difficulty 14) at will, requiring no components, but his target must be able to see him.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: The vampire regains 10 HP at the start of its turn if it has at least 1 HP and isn't in sunlight or running water. If the vampire takes radiant damage or damage from holy water, this trait doesn't function at the start of the vampire's next turn.

entries.name: Spider Climb
entries.description: Passive: The vampire can climb difficult surfaces, including upside down on ceilings, without needing to make an ability check.

entries.name: Vampire Weaknesses
entries.description: Reaction: The vampire has the following flaws:Forbiddance. The vampire can't enter a residence without an invitation from one of the occupants. Harmed by Running Water. The vampire takes 20 acid damage when it ends its turn in running water. Stake to the Heart. The vampire is destroyed if a piercing weapon made of wood is driven into its heart while it is incapacitated in its resting place. Sunlight Hypersensitivity. The vampire takes 20 radiant damage when it starts its turn in sunlight. While in sunlight, it has disadvantage on attacks and ability checks.

entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 2 standard attacks, against one target or split between targets in range.

The called creatures arrive in 1d4 rounds, acting as allies of the vampire and obeying its spoken commands. The beasts remain for 1 hour, until the vampire dies, or until the vampire dismisses them .

The tomb dwarf can have no more than twelve zombies under its control at one time.

entries.name: Berserk

On each of its turns while berserk, the tomb guardian attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, the tomb guardian attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once the tomb guardian goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. The golem's creator, if within Far range of the berserk tomb guardian, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. The tomb guardian must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a Presence Roll (15). If the check succeeds, the tomb guardian ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 HP or fewer, the tomb guardian might go berserk again.

entries.name: Immutable Form
entries.description: Passive: The tomb guardian is immune to any spell or effect that would alter its form.

entries.name: Lightning Absorption
entries.description: Passive: Whenever the tomb guardian is subjected to lightning damage, it takes no damage and instead regains a number of HP equal to the lightning damage dealt.

Additionally, the greatwyrm can now use its Mass Telekinesis action during the next hour. On a success or failure, the creature's speed becomes 0 until the end of its next turn.

No one target can weigh more than 4,000 pounds, and objects can't be targeted if they're being worn or carried. Each targeted creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be restrained in the greatwyrm's telekinetic grip. At the end of a creature's turn, it can repeat the Reaction Roll, ending the effect on itself on a success. At the end of the greatwyrm's turn, it can move each creature or object it has in its telekinetic grip up to Far range in any direction, but not beyond Far range of itself. In addition, it can choose any number of creatures restrained in this way and deal 7d12 magic damage to each of them.

entries.name: Giant Slayer
entries.description: Passive: Any weapon attack that Urgala makes against a giant deals an extra 2d6 damage on a hit.

entries.name: Roleplaying Information
entries.description: A retired adventurer, Urgala owns a respectable inn, the North shield House, and she doesn't want to see it or her neighbors' homes destroyed. She has no tolerance for monsters or bullies. Ideal: "We live in a violent world, and sometimes violence is necessary for survival." Bond: "My home is my life. Threaten it, and I'll hurt you." Flaw: "I know how treacherous and greedy adventurers can be. I don't trust them—any of them."

entries.description: Vaasha is a skilled hunter and tracker who doesn't charge into danger without first assessing the risks. She's not afraid to speak her mind, even to her king. To her, a worthy leader values the truth, no matter how painful it is. Ideal: "I want this conflict over with so that I can return to the quiet stillness of the ocean depths." Bond: "I'll protect this beautiful world from the ravages of evil with my dying breath." Flaw: "I don't care if my words hurt others' feelings."

The curse doesn't advance while the target is in sunlight or the area of a daylight spell; don't count that time. When the cursed target's Charisma becomes 2, it dies, and its head tears from its body and becomes a new vargouille. Casting remove curse, greater restoration, or a similar spell on the target before the transformation is complete can end the curse. Doing so undoes the changes made to the target by the curse.

On each of its turns while berserk, Vasilka attacks the nearest creature it can see. If no creature is near enough to move to and attack, Vasilka attacks an object, with preference for an object smaller than itself. Once Vasilka goes berserk, it continues to do so until it is destroyed or regains all its HP. Vasilka's creator, if within Far range of the berserk golem, can try to calm it by speaking firmly and persuasively. Vasilka must be able to hear its creator, who must take an action to make a Presence Roll (15). If the check succeeds, Vasilka ceases being berserk. If it takes damage while still at 40 HP or fewer, Vasilka might go berserk again.

entries.name: Curse
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The Vistana targets one creature that it can see within Close range of it. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be cursed. The Vistana chooses the curse's effect from the options that follow; other Vistani curses are possible. All such effects deal psychic damage to the Vistani who uttered them when they end:The target is unable to perform a certain kind of act involving fine motor control, such as tying knots, writing, playing an instrument, sewing, or casting spells that have somatic components. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage. The target's appearance changes in a sinister yet purely cosmetic way. For example, the curse can place a scar on the target's face, turn the target's teeth into yellow fangs, or give the target bad breath. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage.A non-magical item in the target's possession (chosen by the DM) disappears and can't be found until the curse ends. The lost item can weigh no more than 1 pound. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 1d6 psychic damage. The target gains vulnerability to a damage type of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage. The target has disadvantage on ability checks and Reaction Rolls tied to one ability score of the Vistana's choice. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 3d6 psychic damage. The target's attunement to one magic item (chosen by the DM) ends, and the target can't attune to the chosen item until the curse ends. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage. The target is blinded, deafened, or both. When this curse ends, the Vistana takes 5d6 psychic damage. The curse lasts until ended with a greater restoration spell, a remove curse spell, or similar magic. It doesn't end when the target dies. If a cursed target is returned to life, the curse remains in effect.

entries.name: Evil Eye
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. As an action, a Vistana can target a creature within Very Close range that the Vistana can see. This magical ability, which the Vistani call the Evil Eye, duplicates the duration and effect of the animal friendship, charm person, or hold person spell (Vistana's choice; spell Difficulty 11), but requires neither somatic nor material components. If the target succeeds on the Reaction Roll, the Vistana is blinded until the end of the Vistana's next turn.A Vistana who uses Evil Eye can't use it again before finishing a short or long rest. Once a target succeeds on a Reaction Roll against a Vistana's Evil Eye, it is immune to the Evil Eye of all Vistani for 24 hours.

If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition. Until the grapple ends, the target has the Restrained condition, is suffocating unless it can breathe water, and takes 2d8 physical damage at the start of each of the elemental's turns. The elemental can grapple one Large creature or up to two Medium or smaller creatures at a time with Whelm. As an action, a creature within Melee range of the elemental can pull a creature out of it by succeeding on a Strength Roll (14). Targets who succeed take half damage.

entries.name: Change Shape
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Wyllow magically polymorphs into a beast or elemental with a challenge rating of 6 or less, and can remain in this form for up to 9 hours. Wyllow can choose whether its equipment falls to the ground, melds with its new form, or is worn by the new form. Wyllow reverts to its true form if it dies or falls unconscious. Wyllow can revert to its true form using its action on its turn. While in a new form, Wyllow retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its Difficulty, movement modes, Strength, and Dexterity are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any special senses, proficiencies, traits, actions, and reactions (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. It can cast its spells with verbal or somatic components in its new form. The new form's attacks count as magical for the purpose of overcoming resistances and immunity to non-magical attacks.

entries.name: Eye Rays
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Xanathar shoots three of the following magical eye rays at random (reroll duplicates), choosing one to three targets it can see within Far range of it:1. Charm Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be charmed by Xanathar for 1 hour, or until Xanathar harms the creature.2. Paralyzing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be paralyzed for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.3. Fear Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened for 1 minute. The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.4. Slowing Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, the target's speed is halved for 1 minute. In addition, the creature can't take reactions, and it can take either an action or its action on its turn, not both. The creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.5. Enervation Ray. The targeted creature must make a Strength Reaction Roll, taking 8d8 magic damage (necrotic) on a failure, or half as much damage on a successful one.6. Telekinetic Ray. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or Xanathar moves it up to Close range in any direction. It is restrained by the ray's telekinetic grip until the start of Xanathar's next turn or until Xanathar is incapacitated. If the target is an object weighing 300 pounds or less that isn't being worn or carried, it is moved up to Close range in any direction. Xanathar can also exert fine control on objects with this ray, such as manipulating a simple tool or opening a door or a container.7. Sleep Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or fall asleep and remain unconscious for 1 minute. The target awakens if it takes damage or another creature takes an action to wake it. This ray has no effect on constructs and undead.8. Petrification Ray. The targeted creature must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.9. Disintegration Ray. If the target is a creature, it must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 10d8 magic damage. If this damage reduces the creature to 0 HP, its body becomes a pile of fine gray dust. If the target is a Large or smaller non-magical object or creation of magical force, it is disintegrated without a Reaction Roll. If the target is a Huge or larger object or creation of magical force, this ray disintegrates a cube (Very Close range) of it.10. Death Ray. The targeted creature must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 10d10 magic damage (necrotic). The target dies if the ray reduces it to 0 HP.

Destroying a tendril deals no damage to Xilonen, which can extrude a replacement tendril on its next turn. A tendril can also be broken if a creature takes an action and succeeds on a Strength Roll (15) against it.

entries.name: Blood Boil
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Y'demi chooses a point within Very Far range of itself, and a radius (Close range) sphere centered on that point fills with a burst of searing, blood-red mist. Each creature of Y'demi's choice that she can see in that area must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, a creature takes 7d10 magic damage (necrotic) and is incapacitated until the end of its next turn. On a success, a creature takes half as much damage and isn't incapacitated. A creature dies if reduced to 0 HP by this necrotic damage.

entries.name: Sanguine Tentacles
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The blood in the copper basin disappears as tentacles of congealed blood fill a cube (Very Close range) centered at a point on the ground that Y'demi can see within Close range of her. The effect lasts for 1 minute, during which time that area is difficult terrain. Any creature entering that area for the first time on a turn or starting its turn there must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be restrained by the tentacles. A creature that starts its turn restrained by the tentacles takes 3d6 physical damage. A creature restrained by the tentacles can use its action to make either a Strength Roll (13) or an Agility Roll (13), ending the restrained condition on itself on a success.

This reduction lasts until the target finishes a long rest, and the target dies if its HP maximum is reduced to 0.

entries.name: Possession
entries.description: Reaction: The yakfolk attempts to magically possess a humanoid or giant. The yakfolk must touch the target throughout a short rest, or the attempt fails. At the end of the rest, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or be possessed by the yakfolk, which disappears with everything it is carrying and wearing. Until the possession ends, the target is incapacitated, loses control of its body, and is unaware of its surroundings. The yakfolk now controls the body and can't be targeted by any attack, spell, or other effect, and it retains its alignment; its Intelligence, Wisdom, and Charisma scores; and its proficiencies. It otherwise uses the target's statistics, except the target's knowledge, class features, feats, and proficiencies. The possession lasts until either the body drops to 0 HP, the yakfolk ends the possession as an action, or the yakfolk is forced out of the body by an effect such as the dispel evil and good spell. When the possession ends, the yakfolk reappears in an unoccupied space within Melee range of the body and is stunned until the end of its next turn. If the host body dies while it is possessed by the yakfolk, the yakfolk dies as well, and its body doesn't reappear.

Reverting to his true form requires an action.

entries.name: Infestation Spores
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Yestabrod releases spores that burst out in a cloud that fills a sphere (Very Close range) centered on it, and the cloud lingers for 1 minute. Any flesh-and-blood creature in the cloud when it appears, or that enters it later, must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature can't be infected by these spores for 24 hours. On a failure, the creature is infected with a disease called the spores of Zuggtmoy and also gains a random form of indefinite madness (determined by rolling on the Madness of Zuggtmoy table in appendix D) that lasts until the creature is cured of the disease or dies. While infected in this way, the creature can't be reinfected, and it must be repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of every 24 hours, ending the infection on a success. On a failure, the infected creature's body is slowly taken over by fungal growth, and after three such failed saves, the creature dies and is reanimated as a spore servant if it's a type of creature that can be (see the "Myconids" entry in the Monster Manual).

entries.name: Sunlight Banishment
entries.description: Passive: If the yeth hound starts its turn in sunlight, it is transported to the Ethereal Plane. While sunlight shines on the spot from which it vanished, the hound must remain in the Deep Ethereal. After sunset, it returns to the Border Ethereal at the same spot, whereupon it typically sets out to find its pack or its master. The hound is visible on the Material Plane while it is in the Border Ethereal, and vice versa, but it can't affect or be affected by anything on the other plane. Once it is adjacent to its master or a pack mate that is on the Material Plane, a yeth hound in the Border Ethereal can return to the Material Plane as an action.

entries.name: Telepathic Bond
entries.description: Passive: While the yeth hound is on the same plane of existence as its master, it can magically convey what it senses to its master, and the two can communicate telepathically with each other.

Every enemy within Very Far range of the hound that can hear it must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be frightened of the hound until the end of the hound's next turn or until the hound is incapacitated. A frightened target that starts its turn within Close range of the hound must use all its movement on that turn to get as far from the hound as possible, must finish the move before taking an action, and must take the most direct route, even if hazards lie that way. A target that successfully saves is immune to the baying of all yeth hounds for the next 24 hours.

entries.name: Petrifying Gaze
entries.description: Reaction: If a creature starts its turn within Close range of the basilisk and the two of them can see each other, the basilisk can force the creature to make a Strength Reaction Roll if the basilisk isn't incapacitated. On a failure, the creature magically begins to turn to stone and is restrained. It must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn. On a success, the effect ends. On a failure, the creature is petrified until freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic.A creature that isn't surprised can avert its eyes to avoid the Reaction Roll at the start of its turn. If it does so, it can't see the basilisk until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If it looks at the basilisk in the meantime, it must immediately make the Reaction Roll. If the basilisk sees its reflection within Close range of it in bright light, it mistakes itself for a rival and targets itself with its gaze.

entries.description: Reaction: When a creature that can see Zalkoré's eyes starts its turn within Close range of Zalkoré, Zalkoré can force it to make a Strength Reaction Roll if Zalkoré isn't incapacitated and can see the creature. If the Reaction Roll fails by 5 or more, the creature is instantly petrified. Otherwise, a creature that fails the Reaction Roll begins to turn to stone and is restrained. The restrained creature must repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of its next turn, becoming petrified on a failure or ending the effect on a success. The petrification lasts until the creature is freed by the greater restoration spell or other magic. Unless surprised, a creature can avert its eyes to avoid the Reaction Roll at the start of its turn. If the creature does so, it can't see Zalkoré until the start of its next turn, when it can avert its eyes again. If the creature looks at Zalkoré in the meantime, it must immediately make the Reaction Roll. If Zalkoré sees itself reflected on a polished surface within Close range of it and in an area of bright light, Zalkoré is, due to its curse, affected by its own gaze.

entries.name: Earth-Shaking Movement
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. After moving at least Very Close range on the ground, the zaratan sends a shock wave through the ground in a Far-radius circle centered on itself. That area becomes difficult terrain for 1 minute. Each creature on the ground that is concentrating must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or the creature's concentration is broken. The shock wave deals 100 thunder damage to all structures in contact with the ground in the area. If a creature is near a structure that collapses, the creature might be buried; a creature within half the distance of the structure's height must make an Agility Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 5d6 physical damage, is knocked prone (Vulnerable), and is trapped in the rubble. A trapped creature is restrained, requiring a successful Strength Roll (20) as an action to escape. Another creature within Melee range of the buried creature can use its action to clear rubble and grant advantage on the check. If three creatures use their actions in this way, the check is an automatic success. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage and doesn't fall prone (Vulnerable) or become trapped.

entries.name: Retract
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The zaratan retracts into its shell. Until it takes its Emerge action, it has resistance to all damage, and it is restrained. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Revitalize or Emerge action.

entries.name: Revitalize
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The zaratan can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell. It regains 5d20 HP. The next time it takes a legendary action, it must take its Emerge action.

entries.name: Emerge
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. The zaratan emerges from its shell and makes one Spit Rock attack. It can use this option only if it is retracted in its shell.

entries.name: Special Equipment
entries.description: Passive: Zargash wears a bat-shaped amulet that has the properties of a ring of feather falling.

entries.name: Cling to Life
entries.description: Passive: The first time Zargash would drop to 0 HP as a result of taking damage, he instead drops to 1 HP.

entries.name: Warhammer
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage.

entries.name: Deathly Ray
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Far range. On a success, deal 4d10+3 magic damage (necrotic).

  • Thaumaturgy (cantrip, Close range)

  • Gaseous Form (3rd level, Melee range): Spell ends on the target if it drops to 0 HP or if it takes a Magic action to end the spell on itself. While in this form, the target's only method of movement…

  • Silence (2nd level, Far range)

entries.name: Animate Corpse
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Zargash targets the lifeless corpse of one Humanoid he can see within Close range of him and commands it to rise, transforming it into a zombie under his control. The zombie takes its turn immediately after Zargash. Animating the zombie requires Zargash's concentration (as if concentrating on a spell). The zombie reverts to an inanimate corpse after 10 minutes, when it drops to 0 HP, or when Zargash's concentration ends.

entries.name: Legendary Resistance
entries.description: Reaction: When this adversary fails a Reaction Roll, you can spend a Fear to make it succeed instead.

entries.name: Regeneration
entries.description: Passive: Zargon regains 20 HP at the start of each of its turns. If Zargon takes cold or fire damage, this trait doesn't function at the start of Zargon's next turn. Zargon dies only if it starts its turn with 0 HP and doesn't regenerate.

entries.name: Shrouded Being
entries.description: Passive: Zargon can't be targeted by divination magic or perceived through magical scrying sensors.

entries.name: Slimy Demise
entries.description: Reaction: When Zargon dies, its body dissolves into foul slime, leaving only its horn behind. Zargon re-forms in 1d10 days, regrowing from the horn. The horn is immune to all damage and can be destroyed only by submerging it in a cleansing waterfall on one of the Upper Planes for 101 days. While the horn is submerged in this way, Zargon doesn't re-form, and the horn slowly dissolves, sending corrupting slime downriver that permanently fouls the water for 10 miles from the place where the horn dissolved. The fouled water is unfit to drink, chokes aquatic wildlife, and withers plants.

entries.name: Relentless (2)
entries.description: Passive: This adversary can be spotlighted up to 2 times per conflict. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

entries.name: Multiattack
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make 4 standard attacks, against one target or split between targets in range.

entries.name: Barbed Tentacle
entries.description: Action: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+6 physical damage. If the target is a Large or smaller creature, it has the Restrained condition, and Zargon can pull the creature up to Close range straight toward itself. Zargon has six tentacles, each of which can grapple one creature. Zargon can move at its full speed while dragging creatures it is grappling.

entries.name: Bite
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 2d12+6 physical damage plus 2d6 magic damage (acid).

entries.name: Gore
entries.description: Action: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d8+6 magic damage. A Very Close-radius invisible sphere of antimagic, like that created by an Antimagic Field spell, surrounds the target. The sphere is centered on the target, moves with the target, and lasts until the end of Zargon's next turn.

entries.name: Slime Wave
entries.description: Action: Spend a Fear to use this ability. Zargon spews slime in a cone (Far range). Each creature in that area that isn't an Aberration or Ooze must make a Strength Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 7d10 magic damage (acid) and has the poisoned condition for 1 minute. On a successful Reaction Roll, the creature takes half as much damage only. A poisoned creature can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.A creature reduced to 0 HP by the acid damage dies and dissolves into a puddle of slime that rises as a gibbering mouther at the start of Zargon's next turn. The creature obeys Zargon's commands and takes its turn immediately after Zargon's. Only a Wish spell can reverse this transformation and restore the creature to life.

entries.name: Defiant Essence
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature casts a spell that targets Zargon or would deal damage to it, Zargon attempts to absorb the magic into its horn. The creature must make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, the creature takes 1d12 magic damage, and the spell it cast fails and is wasted. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Slime Spray
entries.description: Reaction: When a creature ends its turn within Close range of Zargon, Zargon sprays toxic slime at the creature. The target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (with disadvantage if it has the poisoned condition). On a failure, the creature takes 2d6 magic damage (poison). On a successful Reaction Roll, it takes half as much damage. Mark a Stress to use this reaction.

entries.name: Devil's Sight

The target can repeat the Reaction Roll at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
